messages:
Ashwin R.: ran a couple of profiler runs this morning (nsys + perfetto) to investigate the perf regression after the kernel selector change.
Maria C.: nice — which configs? batch sizes / seq len?
Ashwin R.: batch=1,4,8; seq=256/512/1024; gpu=A100-40GB. did both full trace (nsys with CUDA tracing) and sampling (nsys --sample=cpu).
Zach B.: curious about overhead numbers. any ballpark?
Ashwin R.: full trace: end-to-end latency increased ~18-28% at batch=1, ~8-12% at batch=8. sampling runs showed ~2-5% uplift. GPU kernel timelines look very different: full trace inserts lots of small NVTX ranges, which serializes some host-GPU work.
Sam P.: can you paste the command you used?
Ashwin R.: sure:
```bash
# full trace
nsys profile -o run_full --trace=cuda,nvtx --capture-range=nvtx ./bench_infer.sh --model rwd-base --batch 1 --seq 1024
# sampling (lower overhead)
nsys profile --sample=cpu -o run_sample ./bench_infer.sh --model rwd-base --batch 1 --seq 1024
```
Lisa M.: any kernel-level hotspots from the perfetto timeline?
Ashwin R.: yes — in full traces we see repeated small kernels for KV cache loads and a non-negligible cost in our custom attention kernel when sequence>512. Sampling still points to attention as top hotspot but without the NVTX noise.
perf-bot: summary attached: run_full: total_time=120.4s, profiler_overhead_est=22%, top_kernel=attention_fused (42%), kv_load_kern (18%). run_sample: total_time=117.6s, profiler_overhead_est=3.4%.
Maria C.: so full tracing is useful for correctness/timeline but unsafe for perf-sensitive prod runs. we need guardrails.
Zach B.: proposals: default to periodic sampling in prod, enable full trace only on dedicated debug nodes or on-demand via admin API. also add per-route opt-in and a max-duration (e.g., 30s).
Sam P.: add to that: limit full-trace to <1% of requests and require a trace ticket/id so SRE can correlate. and ensure token buckets for profiler starts.
Lisa M.: can we do hybrid? short full-trace warmup (2s) + longer sampling to capture steady-state? that might reduce overhead but still give kernel timing.
Ashwin R.: tried hybrid: 2s full + 28s sampling on a 30s window — overhead about 7% and we captured the NVTX boundaries we needed. seems promising.
Maria C.: we should quantify cost impact: translate overhead to tokens and $ for hosted. ops need to know billing exposure.
Zach B.: also add a runtime guard that refuses full-trace when queueing latency > X or tail > Y, to avoid worsening incidents.
Sam P.: ops checklist: (1) sampling default in prod; (2) admin-only full-trace with TTL + rate limit; (3) per-deployment opt-in for Dedicated customers; (4) instrumentation to tag traces with batch/seq/model.
Lisa M.: implementation detail: use nvtx push/pop only in instrumentation helper and gate it behind a runtime flag so full-trace can enable without recompiling heavy codepaths.
Ashwin R.: +1. I'll open a tiny RFC and include data (nsys csvs + perfetto flame slices).
perf-bot: uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/nsys/run_full_1749854321.tar.gz, s3://redwood-perf/nsys/run_sample_1749854321.tar.gz
deploy-bot: noticed a spike in profiler-start events during the last deploy window (rate ~0.9%).
Maria C.: ok action items: Ashwin open RFC with numbers + hybrid proposal; Zach to draft runtime guard PR; Sam to add quota/rate-limit design; Lisa to refactor NVTX helper. timeline: aim for staged roll by next week, start with non-prod clusters.
Zach B.: will add tests that assert profiler overhead <10% for short traces and <5% for sampling by default.
Sam P.: and we need an e2e dashboard: profiler_events, avg_overhead_pct, active_full_traces. Ops wants alerts if avg_overhead_pct > 7% for 5m.
Ashwin R.: noted. i'll attach perfetto screenshots in the RFC. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Maria C.: thanks — please tag me on the RFC when ready, want to include pricing impact notes.
Lisa M.: small FYI: on older GPUs (V100) sampling overhead was closer to 6-8% vs 2-4% on A100, call it out in the docs.
Sam P.: good call. let's keep the default conservative.
Zach B.: ok wrap-up: sampling-by-default + limited full-trace gated by admin + hybrid warmup option + runtime safety checks + metrics/alerts. I'll create the tracking ticket.
Ashwin R.: filing RFC + attaching raw nsys outputs now.
